theme: An open Friday, girls in St. Pete.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — nothing booked from open to close. The items with any heat on them are two travel bookings that have been waiting and the ICGN plenary you're moderating in Toronto next week.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder is south for the winter, so there's no six-seater in Maine for Christmas. A full-size SUV out of Portland over the holidays is the first thing to sell out — book a refundable one now and adjust dates later. Marked p1, overdue since Sep 14.

needsAttention.title: December break — pick a destination
needsAttention.detail: All four kids, Dec 13–Jan 2, and the book-by date of Oct 15 has already passed. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Shortlist three and settle domestic vs. international.

flagged.title: You're moderating ICGN Plenary 7
flagged.detail: The Autumn Conference is in Toronto next week. Panelists have signed off on your outline and your comp place is registered; the one open loop is Rachit still owing the panel questions.

inbox.noise: A LinkedIn job alert, two retail promos, a Hyatt account summary, and an Evite update — nothing that needs you.

No meetings through the afternoon either; the day's shape is entirely yours.
A quiet close with the girls around in St. Pete.
